message.content: It’s hard to pick just one “best” film from 2020 because tastes vary so much, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** (the Korean dark‑comedy thriller) as the standout of the year. It won the Palme d’Or at Cannes, snagged four Oscars—including Best Picture—and was praised for its sharp social satire, masterful pacing, and genre‑blending storytelling. If you’re looking for something else, other top picks include “1917,” “Soul,” “Tenet,” and “The Trial of the Chicago 7.”
